create.name: Sufi Ruhaniat International
create.bio:
Sufi Ruhaniat International is a Sufi order in the lineage of Hazrat Inayat Khan, the Indian Sufi master who brought his universal Sufi message to the West in 1910. His American disciple Samuel L. Lewis, known as Murshid SAM, formed the organisation shortly before his death in 1971; leadership passed to Pir Moineddin Jablonski, and since 2001 the lineage holder has been Pir Shabda Kahn, who also carries the Chishti vocal tradition of Pandit Pran Nath. The order welcomes seekers of every faith and describes Sufism as a path of experience rather than doctrine.

Its members are initiated students who work with a personal guide and practise zikr, meditation, breath and the recitation of sacred phrases. It is best known for the Dances of Universal Peace, circle dances set to the prayers and mantras of many traditions that Murshid SAM began teaching in San Francisco in the late 1960s. The order also runs esoteric study, a ministry of universal worship and a sacred-agriculture strand, and holds annual retreats such as a Sufi sesshin in California. Its YouTube channel shares classes on Inayat Khan's teaching, anniversary gatherings and dances.

courses.title: 22nd Annual California Sufi Sesshin
courses.description: A week of zikr, meditation, teachings and Dances of Universal Peace at a retreat ranch north of San Francisco, from Sunday dinner to Friday lunch; part-time places must be booked ahead.

courses.title: Jamiat Aam 2027 Retreat - The Living Symphony
courses.description: The order's annual gathering, held in 2027 at a lakeside camp in southern Minnesota to mark a century of Inayat Khan's legacy, with lineage teachings, wazifa, walks, zikr and dances led by Pir Shabda Kahn and senior teachers.

free_resources.title: The Bowl of Saki Commentary
free_resources.description: A daily reading from Hazrat Inayat Khan's Bowl of Saki for every day of the year, each with a commentary by Murshid SAM.

free_resources.title: Dances of Universal Peace and Walking Concentrations
free_resources.description: An introduction to the circle dances and walking practices begun by Murshid SAM, in which a leader teaches a sacred phrase, its tune and movements before the group dances together.

free_resources.title: Media Center
free_resources.description: The order's collection of recorded talks, anniversary celebrations and dance gatherings.
